submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.5 mm gas gap is recommended as it provides the best time resolution (1.3 ns) among the environmentally compliant options. While Mixture-G1 offers superior time resolution (0.9 ns at 2 mm gap), it exceeds the GWP100 limit of 150 and is therefore ineligible per the laboratory's environmental policy. Mixture-G3, although compliant with environmental requirements, delivers significantly worse time resolution (2.014 ns at its optimal 2 mm gap). The recommended configuration of Mixture-G2 at 2.5 mm gap achieves the best possible time resolution while satisfying all hard constraints including the gas gap range (1-3 mm) and the critical GWP100 environmental requirement.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 at 2.5 mm gap achieves 1.3 ns time resolution, which is the best among environmentally compliant mixtures (Mixture-G3 achieves only 2.014 ns at best). Mixture-G1 would provide 0.9 ns but is excluded due to GWP100 violation.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is one of the three candidate mixtures provided in the specifications.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is eligible (mixture_g2_eligible = 1), indicating it meets the GWP100 ≤ 150 requirement. Only 2 out of 3 mixtures are eligible, with Mixture-G1 being ineligible (mixture_g1_eligible = 0).
The recommended gap of 2.5 mm falls within the allowed range of 1-3 mm (gap_min_mm = 1, gap_max_mm = 3).
